text: Thirty minutes. The robot played every one of them, and the game was still there at the end.
Last week, minute seven. Saving world. The robot did not die. The universe just stopped.
Two lab boys grabbed the same clipboard. One wiped it clean while the other was still writing. It took seven million ticks to show up. Now they take turns.
Our test bench watched all this, and called it a pass. Not any more. Seven courses pass. Thirty minutes, no deaths, no crash.
Later in that run, it stood seven minutes looking for lava. We do not know why yet. We are looking too.
Version zero point nine five point six four. Out now.
